confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Taipei price levels for a July 2026 window; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and street-food anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and vary by district, season, and booking channel. Cocktail and wine are bounded using the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation was taken from RBA exchange-rate page text surfaced by search, not from opening the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: East Asian capital cities with a budget-to-mid-range price profile (e.g., Seoul and Hong Kong), adjusted down for Taipei's typically lower restaurant and hotel prices. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly 2.5x and 2.25x the beer anchor, based on local price relationships.
